title: Veloz
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3a10568f849650372968dcdea1ed7e5aa3fb49f.png)
Veloz is a performance modpack designed to deliver the best possible Minecraft experience, regardless of your setup. Built around a carefully curated selection of the finest optimization mods available, it deeply improves rendering, memory management, lighting, and chunk loading speeds.
The result is immediate: significantly higher FPS, improved stability, and consistent smoothness, whether you play solo or on a multiplayer server. Veloz doesn't alter gameplay — it simply makes Minecraft run the way it always should have.
